name: Ribo
maker: Shahjalal University of Science and Technology
def: Social humanoid robot built by RoboSUST, a robotics group at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology in Bangladesh, described as the first to speak Bengali.
facts: First shown in public on 11 December 2015 at a science fiction festival in Shahbag
The team was supervised by Muhammed Zafar Iqbal
Funded by the Bangladesh Science Fiction Society
